detail: a tall slate-skinned being seated motionless on a weathered boulder with hands resting palm-down on their knees, lichen and moss slowly creeping over the hem of their grey mantle while they wait in unhurried silence for a listener across from them to speak

evidence.quote: In conversation they will be content to simply wait, forever if needed, for others to come around to their meaning.

facts.extent: seated figure, 1.8 meters high while seated
facts.scale_ref: moss and alpine lichen bridging the gap between their garment hem and the stone seat
facts.material: slate-grey skin, coarse mineral-dyed wool, slow-growing alpine lichen
facts.state: completely still, unblinking, unbothered by the passage of seasons

note: In dialogue, the Grey Wind never argue or hasten; they simply wait, across years or epochs if necessary, until the other party arrives at their meaning.
